items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: Andrew Anderson, yeah he lived in Maddenville too

ctx.x: Yeah, well he lived in Maddenville, you see. And every time that Janker would launch a ship during World War I, 1917 in the Shifunksu River, they would come and play for the luncheon of the ship. And when they'd come and do that, well they'd always stay home, see. But during the time they were home they'd rehearsal and they'd play joys from, leave from my house and play right around those little country towns like that. And he would come back there. And in 1919, my brother came here to live and I came with him.
Did you know Andy Anderson over that part of the country too?
Andrew Anderson, yeah he lived in Maddenville too, Earl Foster, he's from Maddenville. A cousin I believe was there. Yeah, first cousin Earl Foster.
